description: Log in once and save the session as a storageState file (default playwright/.auth/<name>.json) for tests and the page tools. If a saved session still passes verify it is reused; expired ones log in again. Secrets stay out of chat: fill values use {{env:E2E_PASSWORD}} and {{totp}} (authenticator code from totpSecretEnv).

actionTimeoutMs.description: How long each step waits for its element (default 10000)

actions.description: Login steps. In fill values write {{env:E2E_PASSWORD}} for a secret from the environment and {{totp}} for an authenticator code, never the secret itself. End with a 'wait' on something only signed-in users see

locator.description: Locator or selector, e.g. getByRole('button', { name: 'Next' })

value.description: fill text, press key, select option

name.description: Session name, e.g. 'admin' (default 'user'); saved to playwright/.auth/<name>.json

path.description: Where to save the storageState JSON inside the project (overrides name)

reuse.description: Keep a saved session that still passes verify instead of logging in again (default true)

totpSecretEnv.description: Environment variable holding the authenticator secret (base32 or otpauth:// URI), for {{totp}}

verify.description: How to tell the session works; also used to decide whether a saved session is still valid

notUrl.description: The session is bad if the page lands on a URL containing this, e.g. '/login'

url.description: Page to open to check the session, e.g. /account (default: where login ends)

visible.description: Locator only a signed-in user sees, e.g. getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign out' })

name: save-login

expiresAt.description: save-login: when the first session cookie expires (ISO)

ok.description: false when the call failed (see error) or the tests it ran failed

path.description: save-login: the storageState file, relative to the project

valid.description: validate-selector: the selector parsed and ran

title: Save a login session
